name: Sales Report - per DO
query:
SELECT
    dn.name AS 'DO No.',
    DATE_FORMAT(dn.posting_date, '%%d-%%b-%%y') AS 'Date',
    dn.customer_name AS 'Customer Name',
    dn.status AS 'Status',
    dn.currency AS 'Ccy',
    dn.total AS 'Amount:Currency/ccy:',
    dn.total_taxes_and_charges AS 'Tax:Currency/ccy:',
    dn.discount_amount AS 'Disc:Currency/ccy:',
    dn.grand_total AS 'Total:Currency/ccy:'

FROM
    `tabDelivery Note` AS dn
WHERE
    dn.docstatus = 1
    AND dn.is_return = 0
    AND dn.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
ORDER BY
    dn.posting_date ASC;
